 TORCH_META_FUNC(amax)  /  TORCH_META_FUNC(amin) 
(aten/src/ATen/native/ReduceOps.cpp) via  zero_numel_check_dims

news.aiSummary: The update modifies PyTorch's eager mode amax and amin operations to raise an IndexError when a reduction dimension has zero size.
